title: OVAL: Output-Aware Local Page Bases for KV Cache Compression
abstract: arXiv:2610.06686v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-context decoding, whether over long reasoning traces, long videos, or robot episodes, is increasingly limited by the memory of the key-value (KV) cache. Page-retrieval sparse attention makes each decoding step cheaper by attending only to the top-scoring KV pages. However, it still stores every page exactly, and adds a small digest per page for scoring, so the cache ends up slightly \emph{larger} than the full cache. We propose OVAL, which stores each page as a pair of output-aware low-rank bases that act as both the retrieval index and the storage. A key basis scores the page and rebuilds its keys when the page is selected, and a PCA basis rebuilds its values. The exact pages can then be dropped, and nothing extra is added to the cache. The key idea is that the key basis should be output-aware. A low-rank error in the keys perturbs the attention output at first order, but perturbs the page mass that retrieval ranks only at seco

translated_title: OVAL：用于KV缓存压缩的输出感知局部页面基底
translated_abstract: 长上下文解码——无论是处理长推理轨迹、长视频还是机器人任务片段——正日益受到键值（KV）缓存内存的限制。页面检索稀疏注意力通过仅关注得分最高的KV页面，降低了每个解码步骤的计算开销。然而，它仍然完整地存储每一个页面，并为每个页面额外添加一个用于评分的小摘要（digest），因此缓存最终反而比完整缓存还要略大一些。我们提出OVAL，它将每个页面存储为一对输出感知的低秩基底，这些基底同时充当检索索引和存储本身。关键基底对页面进行评分，并在页面被选中时重建其键（keys）；PCA基底则重建其值（values）。这样，精确的页面可以被丢弃，且不会向缓存添加任何额外内容。其核心思想是关键基底应当是输出感知的：键中的低秩误差会在一阶程度上扰动注意力输出，但只会以二阶程度扰动检索排序所依据的页面质量……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: OVAL提出用一对输出感知的低秩基底同时充当KV页面的检索索引和压缩存储，使长上下文解码中KV缓存被丢弃精确页面后仍不增加任何额外内存开销。
en_tdlr: OVAL stores each KV page as a pair of output-aware low-rank bases that serve as both the retrieval index and the storage, enabling exact pages to be dropped without adding any extra cache memory in long-context decoding.
